standard-dialogue-the-crypt.npc: There's nothing good to drink here.
Blood's only good if there's meat to go with it.

standard-dialogue-the-crypt.player: Why even come here if there's nothing for you to drink?

standard-dialogue-the-crypt.npc: My business is none of your business. Go poke your nose somewhere else.

standard-dialogue-lord-myrmel-s-home-bef.npc: Don't disturb me. I need to guard the tithes.

standard-dialogue-lord-myrmel-s-home-bef.player: Why? Where would they even go if they escaped?

standard-dialogue-lord-myrmel-s-home-bef.npc: Escape? I'm not here to stop them escaping. I'm here to stop them getting stolen.
Now take your stupid questions somewhere else. I have a job to do.

standard-dialogue-lord-myrmel-s-home-aft.npc: This town is so boring now. Want to spice things up a bit?
That's right. You look like someone who might like to kill a few vampyres.

standard-dialogue-lord-myrmel-s-home-aft.player: If I wanted to kill vampyres, surely I could just do that?

standard-dialogue-lord-myrmel-s-home-aft.npc: But there's no fun in that. You want to get them angry first! So angry that they just keep coming! I have a way.
I've put together a little something. I call it a garlic cocktail. It's disgustingly potent, especially to a vampyre. The smell literally fills them with rage. Want to buy one?
Want to buy a garlic cocktail?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-not-d.text: Note: This dialogue is removed after the third fight against Lowerniel in The Blood Moon Rises.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-not-d.npc: You shouldn't be here, slave. Go back to your master before you get yourself killed.
